title: Pael's Legion
description: Doubles Block gained from a card, then goes to sleep for 2 turns.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Summons a pet companion with random appearance (eyes, horns, spikes, or wings). Block doubling is multiplicative and triggers once per cooldown cycle. After doubling Block on a card play, the relic enters cooldown for 2 turns before it can double Block again. The pet displays the current cooldown counter via animations: BlockTrigger when activated, SleepTrigger when cooling down, WakeUpTrigger when reactivating.
